reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. Our native sparse cellular automata now keeps ponds affordable and enhances the flow map. You can dig, raise, and shape your landscape without freezing the frame. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Provincia - Water Mechanics Overhaul
steam.body: We're excited to share that we've revamped the water mechanics in Provincia! With our latest update, water depth now integrates directly with terrain modifications, allowing for a smoother gameplay experience. You can shape your landscape without interruptions. Read more about these changes in our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
